bindingGap.note: BlobBatchAnchor.sol and core BoundedTaskRollup.sol have NO cross-reference or mandatory binding. BlobBatchAnchor does not call BoundedTaskRollup, and BoundedTaskRollup is unaware of BlobBatchAnchor. A real on-chain challenge+settlement against BoundedTaskRollup via a blob anchor is NOT implemented. This script verifies the anchor only and does NOT claim a closed loop.
